prompt: Vertical 9:16 black-and-white 1930s press flash photograph, caught mid-raid. A figure in a black balaclava stands in the doorway. The balaclava has no eye, nose or mouth holes, so no skin shows anywhere; a large white ring is stitched round the whole face, and one small red triangle with rounded corners, pointing down, sits high inside the ring on the right-hand side of the picture. Gloves on both hands; no robot parts. In the harsh flash, two suited men freeze mid-handshake, faces half turned away, over a rifle crate; its stamps "APPROVED BY THE CONSERVATIVE PARTY" and "APPROVED BY THE LABOUR PARTY" are the only colour, red ink. Fresh banknotes spill across the floor. Thanks.
